title: Dracula
subtitle: The Harker Papers
tagline: Whitby, Exeter, London. Someone has to keep the record.
seriesBlurb: Dracula is one entry in the Dispatches series of document-driven branching narrative games.

adviser.name: Professor Van Helsing
adviser.advisedNote: The Professor takes out his notebook and tells you, quietly, exactly what each choice below will cost you.
adviser.remedyNote: The Professor carries one remedy in his bag. It will lift one of your reserves, and it will cost you elsewhere. He can give it once, so choose carefully.
